text:
ashwin: Heads-up — ran onboarding eval for `quant-ggml-7b-v2` and S3 trace bucket spiked by 30GB overnight. Not sure if runner duplicated KV caches for each sample.
marie: Oof. Did the runner capture full attention matrices or just outputs?
sara: I saw a deploy alert from trace-uploader earlier: `413 Payload Too Large` for one multipart upload. Might be a few huge per-sample files.
nashwin: yep, some samples have per-sample artifacts ~40MB each. They include `kv_cache.bin` snapshots and full token-level scores.
leo: That's unexpected; runner shouldn't snapshot KV cache per sample. We only do that for debug-mode. Was debug-mode accidentally enabled?
nashwin: Not that I know. CI job is `eval/runner/v2` — logs show config: `--trace-format full --include-kv true` which is defaulted by mistake after the config flag rename.
marie: So two problems: 1) accidental switch enabling heavy capture, 2) traces contain potential PII in `input_text` field — need redaction before upload.
sara: Agree. Also storage cost aside, we need to avoid inflating dashboard metrics. Our trace ingestion pipeline computes `sample_bytes` and indexes into clickhouse. If we spike, dashboards show bogus latency/cost per-sample.
trace-uploader: automated: upload failed 2026-02-18T02:44:12Z - HTTP 413 for object `traces/1780456789/quant-ggml-7b-v2/sample-0123.bin` (size 42,516,789). Retrying 2/3.
nashwin: here's the relevant runner config block that caused it:
```
runner: {
  trace_format: "full",
  include_kv: true,   # <-- was meant to be false for eval runs
  sample_compression: "none"
}
```
marie: Quick mitigation: change `include_kv:false`, enable `sample_compression: zstd:6`, and add `redact_fields: [\"input_text\", \"user_id\"]` in runner. Also set `max_sample_upload_bytes: 5_000_000` and have uploader split/strip beyond that.
leo: For longer-term: update trace schema to v3 with three artifact tiers: `summary.jsonl` (always), `tokens.zst` (tokens + scores, optional), `kv.bin` (debug-only, gated). Add schema flag `tier: summary/tokens/debug`.
sara: And CI: make job `eval/runner` assert that no uploaded artifact > 6MB unless `tier==debug`. Add rule to fail PRs that flip `include_kv` on without owner approval.
marie: Also need privacy guard: runner should run a `pii-check` step before upload and strip or hash any detected emails/SSNs. We can reuse the redaction lib from `eng-security`.
nashwin: I've opened a quickfix PR to change defaults and add zstd compression: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eval-runner/pulls/421 (WIP).
trace-uploader: automated: backoff succeeded, uploaded object `traces/1780456789/quant-ggml-7b-v2/sample-0123.summary.jsonl` (size 14,823).
leo: Good. Follow-ups:
- marie to spec v3 trace schema + example records (owner: marie)
- ashwin to patch runner defaults + add max_sample_upload_bytes (owner: ashwin)
- sara to add CI assertion & dashboard guardrails (owner: sara)
- eng-security to advise on PII redaction integration (cc @eng-security)
marie: I'll draft the schema today. Quick note on metrics: add `trace_tier` tag on ingestion and `sample_bytes_breakdown` metric (summary/tokens/debug) so dashboards can attribute costs.
sara: For alerts, create a Prom rule: `sum(trace_bytes{env=prod}) by (team) > 5e9` over 1h => page oncall. Avoid paging for small internal evals by adding `team=eval-ci`.
nashwin: Anyone seen duplication from KV cache being identical between samples? If so we can dedupe server-side using content-hash and store as shared blob. That would cut a lot.
leo: Good idea — add `content_sha256` to artifacts and make the uploader check for existing blob before upload. PR to storage layer needed.
marie: OK copying next steps into a GH issue and tagging owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
nashwin: Thanks — I'll monitor S3 usage and pause large eval batches until fixes land.
leo: I'll queue the schema PR review tomorrow morning.
sara: I'll wire the CI check and add the dashboard metric.
trace-uploader: automated: note: consider enabling multipart chunking + zstd before upload to avoid future 413s.
marie: Closing loop: prioritize P0 fixes: runner default change, max upload size, quick PII redaction hook. Then v3 schema and dedupe.
